CAUSE 2 (A FEED THAT ROLLS FORWARD) IS STILL OPEN and confirmed live today: the fix carries only `## [` blocks — its own comment says 'live listing content still turns over normally' — and a rolled-off listing line is plain body. Not a roll-off and not a failed fetch — the date, time and price are unchanged and still verify, while the billing is rewritten. comedy-dani-castaneda-0816 quoted 'Dani Castañeda presenta Amigos en Común'; the club now lists the SAME 7:00 PM slot as 'Amigos en común a beneficio del terremoto de Colombia'.
